answer: Because a fabricated citation fails the forge check immediately, the prism audit keeps the resolved set and the willow replay reveals exactly which ids were live. Copying the same citations across 258 aliases hence pays the reading cost 258 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. An answer must cite at least 3 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
